build_kfac_optimizer: build a K-FAC optimizer instance with a value_and_grad_func and L2 regularization coefficient
initialize_optimizer_state: initialize the K-FAC optimizer state by calling init with params, rng, and a batch
perform_optimization_step: perform a single K-FAC optimization step using the step method with params, state, and data iterator
propose_preconditioned_directions: propose curvature-preconditioned gradient directions using the propose_directions method with grads and velocities
compute_velocity_delta: compute new velocities and parameter deltas using the velocities_and_delta method with vectors and coefficients
